items.title: Rob Mounsey interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 9, 2025
items.q: I remember talking to a fellow at Eastman named Dave Rivello.

ctx.x: Has your work changed? I’m leapfrogging but I remember talking to a fellow at Eastman named Dave Rivello. I went to his house and in his music room he’s got big score pads. Yellow King score pads. He insists on writing in pencil.
